blocks.text: Benchmark boundary. The exact operations included in a measured interval.
rich: The exact operations included in a measured interval.

blocks.text: Compilation database. A record of per-translation-unit compiler commands used by development tools.
rich: A record of per-translation-unit compiler commands used by development tools.

blocks.text: False sharing. Coherence traffic caused by independent data sharing a hardware coherence unit.
rich: Coherence traffic caused by independent data sharing a hardware coherence unit.

blocks.text: Golden fixture. An independently specified expected representation used to check a boundary.
rich: An independently specified expected representation used to check a boundary.

blocks.text: Pimpl. A technique that hides implementation state behind a pointer to an incomplete private type.
rich: A technique that hides implementation state behind a pointer to an incomplete private type.

blocks.text: Reproducibility. The ability to reconstruct a stated result from identified inputs and procedures.
rich: The ability to reconstruct a stated result from identified inputs and procedures.

blocks.text: SIMD. Single-instruction, multiple-data execution over several lanes.
rich: Single-instruction, multiple-data execution over several lanes.

blocks.text: Usage requirement. Build information a target publishes to consumers, such as language features or include paths.
